text_block_list.text: One day, with the Takarazuka Kinen just around the corner—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—I see. Mr. Marimoguma
must really have it rough at work...

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's having a tough time, huh." "Hang in there!"
"Life's rough..." "I feel ya."
"It's so easy to get caught up in your own stuff."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...Fewer people are showing up to the streams again.
I can tell there's still a cloud hanging over everyone's hearts—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...I have to encourage them. I have to support them.
Keep smiling, keep smiling, keep smiling—)

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text: "Loves-chan, are you doing okay?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Are you tired?" "The race is coming up soon, after all."
"Don't push yourself too hard." "I'm a bit worried."
"Loves-chan is doing her best!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ah, umm—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
――... Aha, sorry♪
I'm putting the final touches on for the Takarazuka Kinen,
so I'm super fired up right now!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Since you made today's training pretty hard, maybe I was just a little tired?
I'll make sure to get proper rest, so don't worry♪

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Got it!" "Resting is important!" "Can't wait for the race!"
"Wish I could've gone in person~!"
"My dream is Loves-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (————————I'm such an idiot.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
…………Instead of encouraging them,
what am I doing making them worry?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Like this... no matter how much time passes, I'll never...
be able to support the community members...!"
—The day of the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
choice_data_list: Loves, why don't you try taking a deep breath?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's with you all of a sudden?
choice_data_list: You seemed a little nervous, so...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha♪
Maybe I just got a little swept up
in the Grand Prix excitement♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-kun.
Thanks to you, I've calmed down a bit♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-chan.
Thanks to you, I've calmed down a bit♪

"...Though they said so,
deep down, something felt off."
Loves Only You's expression today seemed somewhat... unnatural. I feel like she's forcing herself, but I can't tell why...
choice_data_list: ...Hey, Loves. If you'd like, do you want to—
……Hey, Loves. If you'd like, for a little while—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun!
My body is itching to run already,
so I'm heading over to the paddock now!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer-chan.
My body is itching to run, so
I'm gonna head over to the paddock already!”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Count on us! Today, our run will take the win once again!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Alright then, I'm off!

Loves Only You had left as if fleeing from something.
Seeing her like that only deepened the unease within me...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...What am I doing?
Making even my Trainer-kun worry...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...What am I doing?
Making even my Trainer-chan worry...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sorry, Trainer.
I promise I'll give it the absolute best run of my life...!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sorry, Trainer-chan.
I promise I'll give it the best run of my life...!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (What is this... pressure stabbing into my entire body...?! Could it be—)
—It's finally time, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Our... Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Chrono-chan—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(She's like a completely different person...!
I've never felt such a fierce intensity from her before—)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Will you... hit me with everything you've got?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Of course.
After all... we made a promise.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...That's right. For Chrono-chan's sake,
and for all the commu-members,
I won't let myself be intimidated...!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin.
—Our Grand Prix!
